weapon_effects.prompt: Use case: game-asset. Transparent production attack-effect atlas for VOLT. Original detailed superhero comic art in Jorge Jimenez's visual style: expressive black ink brush contours, finely hatched shadow facets, irregular organic energy shapes, crisp cel colour and small halftone clusters; no bloom blur, no soft gradients, no neon UI. EXACT FIVE equal COLUMNS and FOUR equal ROWS, twenty separate effects, no figures, no weapons, no text, labels, grid or scenery. Every effect entirely inside its cell with at least 18 percent transparent padding on all sides, never touches neighbouring cells. Each effect points RIGHT or expands from cell centre with tightly bounded edges; ink strokes visible at game scale. Columns express five different weapon motions: 1 short forward boxing impact crescent and jagged contact burst; 2 long thin piercing bolt with branching splinter tips; 3 angular ground-splitting heavy impact, low wide fan of cracked energy plates; 4 swift curved ribbon of three speed afterimages ending in a starburst; 5 circular spinning disc wake, interrupted curved trail around a clearly empty transparent centre. Rows express four heroic powers: row1 luminous ivory and warm golden light; row2 cool steel-blue translucent force-field facets; row3 deep violet and lavender psychic refraction; row4 vivid forest-green organic thorned vines, leaf shapes and serrated barbs. Keep the visual language consistent, each cell a richly hand-inked VFX illustration, genuinely transparent alpha background, no grey checkerboard painted into output, no rectangular background panels, no drop shadow. No central solid white blobs. These are weapon-impact flourishes, not logos or icons.
weapon_effects.cleanup_prompt: Remove all background haze and fit each of twenty effects within its own cell with transparent margins; preserve ink contours and cel facets.
